hooks.command: bash -c 'FILE="$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH"; if [ -z "$FILE" ]; then exit 0; fi; case "$FILE" in *.yml|*.yaml) if echo "$FILE" | grep -q ".github/workflows"; then echo "BLOCKED: Do not modify CI/CD workflows without explicit approval" >&2; exit 2; fi;; esac; exit 0'

bash -c 'FILE="$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH"; if [ -z "$FILE" ]; then exit 0; fi; case "$FILE" in */tree-sitter-al/src/*|*/tree-sitter-al/bindings/*) echo "BLOCKED: This is a generated file in tree-sitter-al. Edit grammar.js or the generators instead, NOT the generated output." >&2; exit 2;; */tree-sitter-al/grammar.js|*/tree-sitter-al/generator/*|*/tree-sitter-al/queries/*|*/tree-sitter-al/data/*|*/tree-sitter-al/tests/*) exit 0;; */tree-sitter-al/node_modules/*) echo "BLOCKED: Do not edit node_modules." >&2; exit 2;; esac; exit 0'

bash -c 'CMD="$CLAUDE_BASH_COMMAND"; if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE "cargo (check|build|test|clippy)" && ! echo "$CMD" | grep -qE "exclude zed-al|\-p (al-|zed-al.*wasm32)"; then echo "WARNING: Workspace cargo commands must exclude zed-al (add --exclude zed-al) unless targeting wasm32-wasip1" >&2; exit 2; fi; exit 0'
bash -c 'CMD="$CLAUDE_BASH_COMMAND"; if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE "git\s+push.*\s(main|master)"; then echo "BLOCKED: Direct push to main/master. Use feature branches." >&2; exit 2; fi; exit 0'

bash -c 'CMD="$CLAUDE_BASH_COMMAND"; if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE "git\s+commit"; then cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && if ! cargo fmt --all -- --check 2>/dev/null; then echo "BLOCKED: Code not formatted. Run cargo fmt --all and /before-commit before committing." >&2; exit 2; fi; fi; exit 0'

bash -c 'FILE="$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH"; if [ -z "$FILE" ]; then exit 0; fi; case "$FILE" in *.rs) if grep -qE "const\s+(AL_BUILTIN_FUNCTIONS|AL_OBJECT_BODY_KEYWORDS|GLOBAL_BUILTINS|AL_KEYWORDS|BUILTIN_TYPES|AL_SYSTEM_FUNCTIONS|AL_DATA_TYPES|TRIGGER_NAMES|AL_RESERVED_WORDS)" "$FILE" 2>/dev/null; then echo "BLOCKED: Hardcoded AL language values detected in $FILE. Use LanguageData or al-symbols instead." >&2; exit 2; fi;; esac; exit 0'
bash -c 'FILE="$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH"; if [ -z "$FILE" ]; then exit 0; fi; case "$FILE" in *.rs) cargo fmt --all 2>/dev/null;; esac; exit 0'
bash -c 'FILE="$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH"; if [ -z "$FILE" ]; then exit 0; fi; case "$FILE" in *.rs) cargo clippy --workspace --exclude zed-al --message-format=short 2>&1 | head -20;; esac; exit 0'
bash -c 'FILE="$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH"; if [ -z "$FILE" ]; then exit 0; fi; case "$FILE" in */Cargo.toml) cargo machete 2>&1 | head -15;; esac; exit 0'

bash -c 'FILE="$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH"; if [ -z "$FILE" ]; then exit 0; fi; case "$FILE" in */Cargo.toml) cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && for crate in al-syntax al-symbols al-semantic; do if grep -q "al-core" "crates/$crate/Cargo.toml" 2>/dev/null; then echo "BLOCKED: $crate depends on al-core — violates dependency rules" >&2; exit 2; fi; for other in al-syntax al-symbols al-semantic; do if [ "$crate" != "$other" ] && grep -q "$other" "crates/$crate/Cargo.toml" 2>/dev/null; then echo "BLOCKED: $crate depends on $other — foundation crates must not depend on each other" >&2; exit 2; fi; done; done; if grep -q "al-core" "crates/al-daemon-client/Cargo.toml" 2>/dev/null; then echo "BLOCKED: al-daemon-client depends on al-core — violates dependency rules" >&2; exit 2; fi;; esac; exit 0'
